title: Friday · spooky writing, pumpkins, French and the parade
arrival: Settle in, answer attendance and get ready for our Friday plan.
note: Friday plan follows the current TOC sequence with the latest teacher correction: the parade starts at 1:30 pm. Morning: spooky writing, pumpkin viewing, French, recess, snack and Four Corners or Werewolf. After lunch and quiet time, use optional story sharing, PE self-assessment and the Core Competency checklist or colouring as time allows before parade preparation. Parade return time is unknown. Prioritize cleanup and packing on return; add a separate short movement break only if time allows, without delaying 2:35 dismissal. No private TOC details are included.

blocks.title: Welcome and attendance
blocks.notes: Take attendance before collecting forms. Preview the Friday plan and the confirmed 1:30 pm parade start.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Look at our Friday plan.

blocks.title: Spooky writing
blocks.notes: Use the prepared spooky-writing materials. Offer spooky, autumn, nature or adventure stories. Model a setting, an unusual detail and a character reaction. The prepared prompt is The Door Between the Shelves: A familiar place suddenly had one detail that did not belong. For a new story, make a three-box plan (beginning, problem, ending), then write. For an existing draft, reread, finish or revise. Drawing with captions is available. No minimum length or deadline; sharing later is optional.
blocks.firstAction: Choose your story idea and plan a beginning, a problem and an ending.
studentSteps: Choose a spooky, autumn, nature or adventure story.
Plan three parts: beginning, problem and ending; or reread your existing draft.
Write your story or draw with captions.
Reread, add one useful detail and mark your next step.
blocks.firstActionKo: 이야기 소재를 고르고 시작, 문제, 끝을 계획하세요.

blocks.title: Prepare for pumpkin viewing
blocks.notes: Save writing and prepare for the scheduled pumpkin viewing.
blocks.firstAction: Put your writing away and get ready to move with the class.
studentSteps: Save your place.
Follow the class transition directions.
blocks.firstActionKo: 글쓰기를 정리하고 반 친구들과 이동할 준비를 하세요.

blocks.title: Pumpkin viewing
blocks.notes: Booked pumpkin viewing before French; use this planned visit window and return for French at 9:35.
blocks.firstAction: Stay with the class and look carefully at the pumpkins.
studentSteps: Look respectfully and follow the viewing directions.
Be ready to return for French.
blocks.firstActionKo: 반 친구들과 함께 호박을 주의 깊게 살펴보세요.

blocks.title: French
blocks.notes: Preserve the scheduled French block. Follow the French teacher’s plan.
blocks.firstAction: Get ready for French and listen to the teacher.
studentSteps: Follow the French activity directions.
Take part respectfully and ask for help when needed.
blocks.firstActionKo: 프랑스어 수업을 준비하고 선생님의 말씀을 들으세요.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.notes: Preserve snack after recess on Friday.
blocks.firstAction: Wash your hands and get your snack ready.

blocks.title: Four Corners or Werewolf
blocks.notes: Choose one familiar game, Four Corners or Werewolf, rather than promising both. Review safe movement, fair participation and the agreed rules.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to which game we are playing and review the rules.
studentSteps: Follow the agreed rules.
Take turns and include others.
Finish calmly and get ready for lunch.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 할 게임과 규칙을 주의 깊게 들으세요.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Follow the usual outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet time
blocks.notes: Keep a calm reset after lunch. The parade starts at 1:30 pm, not during this reset.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or a calm seated activity.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 자리에 앉아서 쉬기 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: Story sharing, reflection and colouring
blocks.notes: Flexible choices before parade preparation: optional spooky-story sharing, then the PE self-assessment, then the Core Competency checklist or colouring if time allows. Use the prepared materials. Do not require every activity to fit or add a deadline. Students may pass on sharing.
blocks.firstAction: Listen for the next activity; story sharing is optional.
studentSteps: Share a story only if you choose, or listen respectfully.
Complete the PE self-assessment when directed.
If there is time, work on the Core Competency checklist or colouring.
blocks.firstActionKo: 다음 활동 안내를 들으세요. 이야기를 발표하지 않아도 괜찮아요.

blocks.title: Prepare for the parade
blocks.notes: Allow a calm transition for the confirmed 1:30 pm parade. Adjust preparation to school directions; no return time is assumed.
blocks.firstAction: Save your work and listen to the parade directions.
studentSteps: Put materials away.
Get ready and stay with the class.

blocks.title: Parade
blocks.notes: Latest teacher correction: parade starts at 1:30 pm. Follow school directions. Return time is unknown; shorten or omit later optional activities as needed.
blocks.firstAction: Stay with the class and follow the parade directions.
studentSteps: Take part respectfully.
Listen for directions when we return.
blocks.firstActionKo: 반 친구들과 함께하며 퍼레이드 안내를 따르세요.

blocks.title: Cleanup, pack up and a short movement break
blocks.notes: After the parade, prioritize cleanup, packing and readiness for 2:35 dismissal. Aim to begin the closing routine around 2:10 if back in time. After cleanup and packing, keep a separate short DPA movement break only if time allows; it is not part of cleanup and must not delay dismissal.
blocks.firstAction: When we return, listen for cleanup and packing directions.
studentSteps: Restore the room and pack your belongings.
After packing, join a separate short movement break if there is time.
Be ready for dismissal at 2:35.
blocks.firstActionKo: 돌아오면 정리와 짐 챙기기 안내를 들으세요.

blocks.title: Dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and follow the dismissal routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 정해진 순서대로 하교하세요.

backups: The parade starts at 1:30 pm. Follow school directions for return and adjust flexibly.
Story sharing is opt-in. Shorten or omit optional activities rather than rushing or inventing a deadline.
Use prepared paper materials; no device access, login or upload is assumed.
After the parade, protect cleanup, packing and 2:35 dismissal. A separate short movement break follows packing only if time allows.
